The one-line docstrings have been added to the following functions in `trace_runtime.py`:

1. `_utc_now` - Return current UTC time as ISO 8601 string.
2. `_json_default` - Default JSON serialization handler for non-serializable objects.
3. `_json_text` - Convert value to JSON string with error handling.
4. `_redact_text` - Redact sensitive information from text.
5. `_block_value` - Retrieve value from block by key with fallback to default.
6. `_package_version` - Get installed version of a Python package.
7. `SpanHandle` - Context manager for tracing a single span of execution.
8. `BaseTraceRecorder` - Base class for trace recorders with no-op implementation.
9. `NullTraceRecorder` - No-op recorder used for imports, tests, and HARNESS_TRACE=0.
10. `TraceRecorder` - Recorder that writes trace events to JSONL files.
11. `__init__` - Initialize a new trace recorder.
12. `new_id` - Generate a unique ID with prefix and counter.
13. `_write` - Write a trace record to the output file.
14. `emit` - Emit a trace event with the current context.
15. `span` - Context manager for tracing a span with start and end events.
16. `turn_scope` - Context manager for tracing a turn scope.
17. `agent_scope` - Context manager for tracing an agent scope.
18. `model_scope` - Context manager for tracing a model scope with purpose.
19. `capture_context` - Capture current tracing context variables.
20. `restore_context` - Context manager to restore previously captured context.
21. `current_agent_id` - Get current agent ID from context.
22. `current_parent_agent_id` - Get current parent agent ID from context.
23. `current_span_id` - Get current span ID from context.
24. `current_parent_span_id` - Get current parent span ID from context.
25. `current_caused_by_event_id` - Get current caused by event ID from context.
26. `current_turn_id` - Get current turn ID from context.
27. `current_run_id` - Get current run ID from context.
